name: devpost-hackathons
description: Prototype Devpost hackathon guide for Codex: text-first responses everywhere, with rich inline visuals from the bundled Devpost MCP server on hosts that can render them.

interface.shortDescription: A Codex hackathon guide for Devpost participants
interface.longDescription: Prototype Devpost hackathon plugin for Codex: orientation, rules review, resources, the optional guided build tool, submission drafting, and final preflight. Responses are text-first so they work in any Codex host; the bundled Devpost MCP server supplies official event data and renders rich inline visuals on hosts that support them. It intentionally stops short of direct Devpost submission while sponsor, legal, and event copy are still being finalized.
defaultPrompt: Show my hackathon map and next step.
Show the next deadline and what I should do before submitting.
